name: PAVBHAJI MASALA
description: Western India has gifted us with one the most favorite dishes of the country, pav bhaji. It is well known for its good taste along with several health benefits as it consists of a lot of vegetables in mashed form. Sonet pav bhaji masala, with the help of its best seasonings and flavors, helps you cherish out of the world taste of pav bhaji.
usage: Making of Pav bhaji: - Add 2 large chopped onions in 2 to 3 large tbsp of oil and fry till roasted. Add 2 large tomatoes, chili powder, 1 large tbsp Sonet Pavbhaji masala, salt to taste, roast it now. Add 500 to 600 grams of boiled vegetables (potatoes, cauliflower, green peas, capsicum, brinjal), cook for 2-3 minutes, add a tbsp of butter, sprinkle coriander on top. Serve with hot buttered pav and chopped onions with lemon slice.
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: SHAHI BIRYANI MASALA
description: Sonet has successfully developed an aroma and taste that makes your biryani out of the world. This blend is unique in itself as it includes grounds, leaves and also whole spices with them. Biryani can be both vegetarian or non-vegetarian preparation usually made on special occasions in our country. Sonet shahi biryani masala has its own unique taste and aroma which makes anything you add it in tastier.
usage: Making of Shahi biryani: - Take 250 grams of boiled rice. Take 3 tbsp oil, fry finely-chopped 3 onions, 1 tbsp ginger and garlic paste and pour 2 tomato puree, turmeric, chili powder and put aside until cooked. Add half a cup yogurt in it. Now add half tbsp Sonet Shahi Biryani masala, add one-half cup cooked vegetables (green peas, cauliflower, carrots, potatoes, capsicum etc.), salt to taste. Spread half the rice in oiled bowl, add the vegetables. Then spread the remaining rice. Pour two tbsp of desi ghee. Now heat it for 10 to 15 minutes on low flame. Serve hot with curd or salad.
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: CHHOLE MASALA
description: Chhole is known as one of the most liked and nutritious dishes of north India. An “out of the world” blend of 17 pure spices, this is one of the most liked blends in the Sonet collection. This blend has a great balance of taste and flavor and imparts a distinctive taste to chhole which are made from chickpeas. Sonet chhole masala also blends very well in many curries, giving them an exquisite aroma, increasing its taste and flavor.
usage: Making of delicious Chhole: - Take 200 grams chickpeas, soak them overnight, boil the same and keep it aside. Add 3-4 chopped onions in 4-5 large tbsp of oil, cook until becomes golden, add 2 tbsp chili powder and coriander powder. Add 2 large tbsp Sonet Chhole masala, cook for 6-7 minutes on low flame, add 2 chopped tomatoes, 5-6 green chilies, 1 inch finely chopped ginger, add salt to taste. Now pour the boiled chickpeas, cook for 10 minutes, add Sonet Chat masala to enhance the flavor, serve with puri, salad and rice.
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: CHAT MASALA
description: When we think about chat, two things come in our mind, a spice blend and a delicious salad that uses the spice blend. Sonet masala has in store for you a pre-mixed chat masala which is available as a ready to use masala which helps in enhancing the taste of any dish. You just need to sprinkle some Sonet chat masala on salads, fruits or any vegetable, to lift up the taste and flavors instantly.
usage: Making of delicious Aloo Chat: - Boil 500 grams of potatoes, cut and fry until golden color appears. Extract in a bowl and let it cool. Add 2 tbsp fudina sauce, big spoon of lime juice, half inch ginger grated, 1 chopped green chili and salt to taste. Mix them well. Sprinkle one large spoon of Sonet Chat masala and mix well. Add chopped coriander leaves and serve it fresh. Taste of many kinds of fruits and green salads can be enhanced by sprinkling Sonet Chat masala on them.
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: PANI PURI MASALA
description: Sonet pani puri masala is used to enhance the taste of “pani” which is used in the pani puri dish. Pani is added to the fried wheat based puris along with other tasty fillings. The “pani” seasoned with Sonet pani puri masala gives delicious taste to the dish.
usage: Maing of Pani puri: - For 100 puris, add 2 tbsp of Sonet Pani Puri masala in one and a half liters of water and mix it well. Add salt-ginger-peppermint-green chili paste. Mix the lime to taste. Keep the water covered for half an hour. Let it cool. Strain it. Serve with chopped boiled potatoes and bengal gram with Sonet Chat masala to taste and serve with chopped onions and coriander leaves to fill it in the puris.
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: SABJI MASALA
description: Sonet sabji masala is a popular blend made with high quality and freshly ground spices that comes in handy in preparing many Indian sub continental dishes, usually different sabjis.
usage: Making of delicious Sabji: - As always along with your ordinary masala, add 500 grams of cooked vegetables and 1-2 tbsp Sonet Sabji Masala. Cook for 3-4 minutes. Cover it for some time to get appetizing smell of masala and to enhance the taste. Serve it hot with roti and rice.
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: SAMBHAR MASALA
description: Southern India has gifted us with an extraordinary recipe named sambhar which is seen as a humble and healthy food. Sonet sambhar masala offers the best taste to the dish filled with various vegetables, dals and spices and condiments that fulfills many nutrients of the body.
usage: Making of delicious Sambhar: - In half litre of water, pressure cook 2 cups of red gram split (tuvar dal). Add 3 tbsp of oil in a vessel and add mustard seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida, stir and fry, now add chopped onions, green chili and cook for 2 minutes. Add 2 chopped tomatoes and cook till it becomes a paste. Add 2 cups of water, 2 tbsp tamarind paste, salt to taste and add 2 tbsp Sonet Sambhar Masala. Blend the cooked-dal with blender, add to the bowl and boil for 5 to 10 minutes with chopped coriander, serve hot with idlis or dosas.
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: CHICKEN MASALA
description: Sonet chicken masala brings the mouth-watering aroma and unmatched taste to the most popular dishes all across the globe based with chicken in them. The spices in the sonet chicken masala gives a balanced taste along with other ingredients in the chicken curry, making it to be wanted more and more.
usage: Making of delicious Chicken curry: - Take 500 grams to 750 grams of chicken washed thoroughly and cut them. Add 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp ginger garlic sauce, 1 tbsp turmeric, 3 tbsp yogurt and salt to taste. Keep it for 1 hour. Now take 4 finely chopped onions, fry it in 4 tbsp oil till brown or crisp. Add 2 to 3 chopped green chilies, 1 tbsp ginger garlic sauce, 1 tbsp coriander powder, turmeric powder and 3 tbsp Sonet Chicken masala. Fry for 1 minute. Add 3-4 chopped tomatoes to marinate chicken. Cook for 10 minutes. Serve hot with rice or bread
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: MEAT MASALA
description: Sonet meat masala can be used to make any meat dish taste out of the world with its best flavors of all freshly blended spices in it.
usage: Making of delicious Meat curry: - Wash and clean 500 grams of meat. Marinate the meat with paste of 2-3 onions, 1 tbsp paste of ginger, garlic paste, 3-4 tbsp curd and salt to taste. Marinate for 2 hours. Cook 2-3 finely chopped onions in 3-4 big spoons of oil. Cook till onion turns brown or crisp. Now add the marinated meat in the pan and add 2-3 tbsp of Sonet Meat masala. Stir for 6-7 minutes. Add a glass of water. Now pressure cook it for 10-15 minutes. Now, sprinkle fresh coriander and serve it hot with roti and rice.
packaging: Packaging available in 50 gm pack / 1 Kg pack

name: FENNEL JUICE POWDER

usage: Making of delicious Fennel Juice: - Sonet Fennel Juice powder is a mixture of Fennel seeds powder and rock sugar powder. Take one litre of water in a jug and add 80 to 90 grams of Sonet Fennel Juice powder according to taste and mix well. Let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes and then serve. One can also add lemon juice to enhance the taste.
